_comment: Public platform demos from the Fuuz Demo Share Bunny Stream library (id 705177). Curated snapshot, NOT auto-fetched at build time: the Asset model sits behind a tenant JWT, and putting one in CI secrets is a decision for a human. Refresh with `node build/refresh-demos.mjs` locally (needs FUUZ_HOST/FUUZ_TENANT/FUUZ_TOKEN) — it rewrites `summary` and `lengthSeconds` from the tenant and leaves `title` alone, because titles here are hand-written and the source names are raw filenames.

collections.name: Platform Demos
collections.blurb: Recorded walkthroughs of the platform, start to finish.

videos.title: Introduction to Fuuz
videos.summary: Founder Craig Scott on where Fuuz came from and how it addresses IT and OT integration in manufacturing — why legacy systems break on update, and what a cloud-native platform does differently.

videos.title: The Mental Shift
videos.summary: What changes when a unified platform replaces monolithic ERP, MES and SCADA systems: one data model instead of silos, visual configuration instead of code, and continuous updates with no downtime.

videos.title: Architecture You Can Touch
videos.summary: The cloud platform and the edge gateway, and the path data actually takes from a CNC to the cloud over OPC UA and MQTT. Covers public, hybrid and private deployment against the same tools and APIs.

videos.title: Applications In Action
videos.summary: How the ISA-95 framework organises the platform, and how a publish-and-subscribe model moves data between ERP, MES and machines in real time — in both directions.

videos.title: Production Execution
videos.summary: Shop-floor execution: barcode-driven data capture at the operator panel, full genealogy of materials and work orders, bill-of-material consumption, and the progressive path from manual steps to automated ones.

videos.title: Platform Session — Introduction
videos.summary: A short orientation to the session series: the core concepts and the four designer tools, ahead of the platform walkthrough.

collections.name: Recorded Demonstrations
collections.blurb: Individual capabilities, demonstrated against real screens.

videos.title: Production Operations, OEE and In-Line Quality
videos.summary: Overall equipment effectiveness calculated in real time and adjusted as equipment state changes, with drill-down by plant and work centre, schedule attainment against the ERP, and metrics you can redefine for your own environment.

videos.title: Digital Twin — Batch Release and Two-Way Trace
videos.summary: Forward and backward traceability from a serial, lot, batch or production order — linkages, equipment and storage, operator notes, quality checks and the audit trail, exportable to CSV or PDF.

videos.title: Statistical Process Control
videos.summary: Selecting characteristics for analysis, capturing data in-line, in the lab and at inventory, and charting it as X-bar, R or Cpk with custom subgrouping — tied back to the production run, lot or serial it came from.

videos.title: Maintenance, Downtime and Reliability
videos.summary: Work centres linked to their assets, downtime events tracked with mean time between failures and mean time to repair, and a reliability dashboard comparing ninety days of maintenance history.

videos.title: Campaign Management
videos.summary: Grouping production orders into campaigns by product attribute to cut setup and clean-in-place losses, with generated alerts on operational anomalies and role-based control over what the model may read.

videos.title: Tag Subscriptions On The Edge Gateway
videos.summary: Standing up the edge gateway in Docker, pointing it at an OPC simulator instead of a live programmable logic controller, browsing tags, and bulk-subscribing from a filtered CSV.

collections.name: Short Demos
collections.blurb: One idea each, in a few minutes.

videos.title: App Development In Fuuz
videos.summary: Modelling data, building screens and shipping in one place — with a GraphQL API generated the moment a model is defined, and versioning, rollback and governance built into the lifecycle rather than bolted on.

videos.title: Automated Test Harness
videos.summary: End-to-end testing that correlates interface actions with backend logs, so a non-technical analyst can run a full test without writing code.

videos.title: Building An App With Claude
videos.summary: Building a working application in Fuuz through a conversation with Claude, over the platform's own tooling.

videos.title: Claude Writes Fuuz Code
videos.summary: Claude working through the Fuuz tooling in an editor to build data capture for statistical process control — identifying the process steps, building the flow, and fixing validation errors as they surface.

videos.title: Building Apps In Fuuz
videos.summary: A short walkthrough of assembling an application in the platform.
